with hooks, even though its result is only consumed when a passive
cleanup gets deferred to the after-paint flush. During a whole-tree

without cleanups also no longer schedule a pointless after-paint flush.

The fix is complete and validated. ## Summary **Root cause** (`hooks/src/index.js`): the `shouldComponentUpdate` installed by `useReducer` bails out of rendering whenever every pending hook state (`_nextValue`) equals its committed value — which happens when a component sets state and then "undoes" it in the same tick. This bailout ignored incoming props: when a parent-driven diff delivers new props in that same tick, the component was skipped and the prop update was discarded (state got committed via `hookItem._value = hookItem._nextValue` without re-rendering, so the component stayed stalled until a later update). **Fix** (one line, matching upstream preactjs/preact#3739): ```js return shouldUpdate || hookState._component.props !== p ? prevScu ? prevScu.call(this, p, s, c) : true : false; ``` When the SCU is invoked from a parent's diff, `p` (new props) differs from the component's current `props`, so it no longer bails out; when a component re-renders from its own queued flush, `diff` passes a shallow copy of its own vnode so `p === this.props` and the state-undo optimization still works. **Validation**: - `hooks/test/browser/useState.test.js > respects updates initiated from the parent` — previously failed with `
